datasets.name: GaoFen (GF) series satellite imagery (GF-1 and GF-2)
datasets.source: China National Commission for Disaster Reduction
datasets.verbatim: The ground truth was obtained from the China National Commission for Disaster Reduction (http://www.jianzai.gov.cn/DRpublish), with visual interpretation in postevent images.

methods.name: Spatiotemporal context (STC) model
methods.summary: The method uses a spatiotemporal context (STC) model to detect landslides by analyzing feature series (NDVI and PanTex) from multitemporal imagery. It builds a cumulative updated model using a Bayesian framework to compute a confidence map, where a decline in confidence values below zero indicates a landslide.
methods.verbatim: In this letter, we borrowed the concept of STC to build a cumulative updated model by using several multitemporal imageries. The confidence value helps to determine whether the landslide occurs or not.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the custom STC model code is not provided or linked.
